{{Quote|I need a picture of the wide open plains of Dathomir. Try to keep any monsters out of the picture.|[[Omogg]]'s representative, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:W">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Walkabout|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
'''Rhoa Yenth''' was a region of grassy high plains on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was located between the [[Takal Nax]] and [[Yumaou Risoath]] regions.<ref name="SWG" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Omogg]] sent a representative to Dathomir in order to explore the planet. The latter recruited adventurous [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to brave the planet's dangerous wilds and record [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of specific point of interests, including the plains of Rhoa Yenth.<ref name="SWG:W" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rhoa Yenth was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
